description: Bringing Down Costs for Families This day and age, families are struggling to maintain a middle-class life, like the one Kristy was raised in. Families are pressed from all sides, whether from the costs of housing, education, transportation, healthcare, or food. We have to do more to ensure life is affordable for Minnesotans.
